mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM la_instructor i WHERE i.delete_time IS NULL) AS instructorCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM la_course_class c WHERE c.is_delete = 0) AS coursePackCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM la_course_class c WHERE c.is_delete = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_show = 1) AS coursePackOnSaleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM la_community comm WHERE comm.delete_time IS NULL) AS communityCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM la_area a WHERE a.delete_time IS NULL) AS areaCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(o.pay_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.order_amount), 0), 2) AS revenue FROM la_recharge_order o WHERE o.pay_status = 1 AND o.delete_time IS NULL AND (o.refund_status <> 1 OR o.refund_status IS NULL) AND o.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(o.pay_time), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT o.id AS orderId, COALESCE(o.sn, '') AS sn, COALESCE(o.course_class_id, 0) AS courseClassId, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS courseName, COALESCE(c.instructor_id, 0) AS instructorId, COALESCE(ins.name, '') AS instructorName, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.community_id, 0), a.community_id, 0) AS communityId, COALESCE(comm.name, '') AS communityName, COALESCE(c.area_id, 0) AS areaId, COALESCE(a.name, '') AS areaName, COALESCE(o.student_id, 0) AS studentId, COALESCE(s.name, '') AS studentName, COALESCE(o.lesson_count, 0) AS lessonCount, ROUND(COALESCE(o.order_amount, 0), 2) AS orderAmount, o.pay_time AS payTime
ORDER BY o.pay_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT cl.course_class_id, cl.lesson_no
GROUP BY cl.course_class_id, cl.lesson_no ) t

SELECT cl.course_class_id AS courseClassId, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS courseName, COALESCE(c.instructor_id, 0) AS instructorId, COALESCE(ins.name, '') AS instructorName, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.community_id, 0), a.community_id, 0) AS communityId, COALESCE(comm.name, '') AS communityName, COALESCE(c.area_id, 0) AS areaId, COALESCE(a.name, '') AS areaName, cl.lesson_no AS lessonNo, COUNT(*) AS servicePersons, MAX(cl.create_time) AS lastConsumeTime
GROUP BY cl.course_class_id, cl.lesson_no, c.name, c.instructor_id, ins.name, c.community_id, a.community_id, comm.name, c.area_id, a.name ORDER BY cl.course_class_id ASC, cl.lesson_no ASC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}

SELECT b.communityId AS communityId, COALESCE(comm.name, '') AS communityName, COALESCE(g.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(g.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue, COALESCE(g.attends, 0) AS attends FROM (
SELECT comm.id AS communityId FROM la_community comm WHERE comm.delete_time IS NULL UNION
SELECT a.communityId AS communityId FROM () a ) b LEFT JOIN la_community comm ON comm.id = b.communityId AND comm.delete_time IS NULL LEFT JOIN () g ON g.communityId = b.communityId ORDER BY revenue DESC, orderCount DESC, b.communityId ASC

SELECT b.areaId AS areaId, COALESCE(ar.name, '') AS areaName, COALESCE(g.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(g.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue, COALESCE(g.attends, 0) AS attends FROM (
SELECT ar2.id AS areaId FROM la_area ar2 WHERE ar2.delete_time IS NULL UNION
SELECT a.areaId AS areaId FROM () a ) b LEFT JOIN la_area ar ON ar.id = b.areaId AND ar.delete_time IS NULL LEFT JOIN () g ON g.areaId = b.areaId ORDER BY revenue DESC, orderCount DESC, b.areaId ASC

SELECT r.id AS regionId, COALESCE(r.name, '') AS regionName, COALESCE(p.name, '') AS cityName, COALESCE(r.sort, 0) AS sort FROM la_region r LEFT JOIN la_region p ON p.id = r.parent_id AND p.delete_time IS NULL WHERE r.level = 2 AND r.delete_time IS NULL ORDER BY r.sort ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT c.id AS communityId, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS communityName, COALESCE(c.region_id, 0) AS regionId, COALESCE(r.level, 0) AS regionLevel, COALESCE(r.parent_id, 0) AS parentRegionId FROM la_community c LEFT JOIN la_region r ON r.id = c.region_id AND r.delete_time IS NULL WHERE c.delete_time IS NULL ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(c.id, 0) AS courseClassId, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS courseName, COALESCE(cat.id, 0) AS categoryId, COALESCE(cat.name, '') AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.order_amount), 0), 2) AS revenue FROM la_recharge_order o LEFT JOIN la_course_class c ON c.id = o.course_class_id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN la_sports_category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id WHERE o.pay_status = 1 AND o.delete_time IS NULL AND (o.refund_status <> 1 OR o.refund_status IS NULL) AND o.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY COALESCE(c.id, 0), COALESCE(c.name, ''), COALESCE(cat.id, 0), COALESCE(cat.name, '') ORDER BY revenue DESC, orderCount DESC, courseClassId ASC

SELECT COALESCE(c.id, 0) AS coursePackId, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS coursePackName, COALESCE(cat.name, '') AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(p.purchases), 0) AS purchases, COALESCE(SUM(p.buyers), 0) AS enrollCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.orderCount), 0) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.revenue), 0), 2) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT uc.course_class_id AS classId FROM la_user_course uc WHERE uc.delete_time IS NULL AND uc.create_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY uc.course_class_id UNION SELECT o2.course_class_id AS classId FROM la_recharge_order o2 WHERE o2.pay_status = 1 AND o2.delete_time IS NULL AND (o2.refund_status <> 1 OR o2.refund_status IS NULL) AND o2.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY o2.course_class_id ) k LEFT JOIN la_course_class c ON c.id = k.classId AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN la_sports_category cat ON cat.id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT uc.course_class_id AS classId, COUNT(DISTINCT uc.id) AS purchases, COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_id) AS buyers FROM la_user_course uc WHERE uc.delete_time IS NULL AND uc.create_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY uc.course_class_id ) p ON p.classId = k.classId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o2.course_class_id AS classId, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(o2.order_amount) AS revenue FROM la_recharge_order o2 WHERE o2.pay_status = 1 AND o2.delete_time IS NULL AND (o2.refund_status <> 1 OR o2.refund_status IS NULL) AND o2.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} GROUP BY o2.course_class_id ) o ON o.classId = k.classId GROUP BY COALESCE(c.id, 0), COALESCE(c.name, ''), COALESCE(cat.name, '') HAVING purchases > 0 OR revenue > 0 ORDER BY revenue DESC, purchases DESC, coursePackId ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.order_amount), 0), 2) AS revenue FROM la_recharge_order o LEFT JOIN la_course_class c ON c.id = o.course_class_id AND c.is_delete = 0 WHERE o.pay_status = 1 AND o.delete_time IS NULL AND (o.refund_status <> 1 OR o.refund_status IS NULL) AND o.pay_time BETWEEN #{q.startEpoch} AND #{q.endEpoch} AND c.id IS NULL
